post.summary: Create a one-time PayPal payment order
post.description: Creates a PayPal Order for a one-time payment using the Orders v2 API. The user pays once and gets 30 days of access — no recurring billing. A local Subscription record (CREATED status) is persisted before returning the approval link. After the user approves on PayPal, the existing capture-subscription endpoint (`GET /subscription/capture`) will capture and activate the subscription via revalidation.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Public ID of the plan to subscribe to

redirectURI.description: URL to redirect the user to after payment approval

cancelURI.description: URL to redirect the user to if they cancel the payment

url.description: PayPal approval URL — redirect the user here to complete payment

400.description: Bad request, subscription creation failed, or user already subscribed

Language.description: Preferred language code. Falls back to Accept-Language header if not provided. Supported: en (English), es (Español), nl (Nederlands), fr (Français)

password.description: Should meet configured complexity rules (min 4 chars, lowercase, uppercase, numeric)

AccountUpdatePayload.description: At least one of 'name' or 'newPassword' must be provided. 'password' is always required for verification.
